clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society from the depths of the Apothecarium. Once a respected Dalaran scholar, he now directs the Forsaken's search for a New Plague to destroy the Scourge and the living.

Before the Third War, Faranell spent decades studying alchemy alongside Dalaran's learned mages. In life, he sought cures, remedies, and potions to improve mortal health. The Scourge plague killed him, but he rose again as a free-willed Forsaken. His scientific curiosity turned cruel, and he traded healing salves for catastrophic reagents. His encyclopedic knowledge made him one of Queen Sylvanas Windrunner's most valued researchers in the depths of Lordaeron's fallen capital.

From the Apothecarium, Faranell coordinates the Royal Apothecary Society's far-reaching research. He oversees the construction of lumbering abominations and directs apothecaries stationed throughout Lordaeron and beyond. Field researchers gather strange venom, tainted blood, and cursed flora across the continents. Each batch passes through his vats for distillation and refinement.
